description: Château Puy-Servain Calabre's 2015 Terrement Moelleux is a sweet Sémillon with vivid pineapple and quince character. Its generous entry is balanced by fresh acidity, leaving the wine poised rather than heavy.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 500ml bottle of 2015 Château Puy-Servain Calabre Terrement Moelleux.
sommelierNotes: Serve well chilled as an aperitif or with foie gras, white meats, or blue-veined cheese.
